question: Where should the six-faced deity and Vināyaka be placed in relation to the pot?
premises: The six-faced deity is assigned to the pot region
Vināyaka is assigned to the mouth of the pot
Both placements are prescribed in sequence
inference: One should place the six-faced deity in the pot region and Vināyaka at the mouth of the pot.
plain_english: One should place the six-faced one in the region of the pot, and Vināyaka at the mouth of the pot.
